XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Gearbox locked in neutral, gearbox fault warning light illuminated and "Have gearbox checked" warnin
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: POTENTIOMETER | MODULE | CLUTCH | GEARBOX | P1742 | ON | LIGHT | YELLOW | LEVER | DISPLAY | SCREEN | DASHBOARD | INSTRUMENTS | SENSOR | POSITION | SELECTOR | GEAR | ENTER | GEARS |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Cars equipped with robotic gearbox

  • System: Gearbox

  • Device: Gearbox engagement module potentiometer

  • Fault: The gearbox remains stuck in neutral with no possibility of engaging gears, the gearbox fault warning light comes on and the message "Have gearbox checked" appears on the multifunction display

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P1742 (Gear selector position sensor - Mechanical fault)

  • Cause: Faulty gear shift module potentiometer

• Intervention: Check that the clutch module potentiometer is working properly and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: When installing the new component, take care not to accidentally disconnect the connecting rod near the potentiometer.
    The component is accessible from the bottom of the engine compartment, on the driver's side, between the radiator and the gearbox, attached directly to the latter.
